name: manual_f540eb
claim: A path-allowlist hook that resolves its project root from the shell working directory reads only that directory rules, with patterns relative to it: test a candidate rule against the plugin own matcher before writing it, put the rule in every directory you work from, and when a command is blocked report it instead of reshaping the command. Operator-approved exceptions go in the allowlist file.

decisions.notes: Scratchpad and backup-folder rules written with a leading slash never matched, and the same rule worked or failed depending on the directory the previous command left the shell in. Testing patterns against the matcher showed that a negation of the single folder was enough and that a baseline pattern, not the rule, blocked scratchpad logs.
